purpose: Robustness diagnostic after ID270-ID271 controlled risk-penalized pair blends.

interpretation.id270: Strong cap0.16 candidate with lower local than ID269/261 but source exposure remains stress-heavy; useful only after a safer probe.
interpretation.id271: Lowest new local among controlled pair blends, but it directly inherits ID257 on several targets and should be treated as a stress card, not a first probe.
interpretation.first_probe: ID264 remains the cleanest cap0.12 probe; ID267 is the sharper cap0.12 score-targeting alternative.
interpretation.balanced_chase: ID268 remains the best balanced Public-0.55 chase card unless first-feedback proves the high-stress family generalizes.
interpretation.submission_policy: No DACON submission was made by this report.
